added.title: reFX Intros Rippler Physical Modeling Synthesizer
added.excerpt: Rippler is a software synthesizer built around a combination of modal synthesis and subtractive synthesis techniques. The instrument uses banks of resonators to generate sounds without samples, with bi-directional energy coupling between resonators and two independent synthesis layers. Each layer can use parallel or serial resonator routing, with additional oscillators, filters, modulation sources, and effects processing. Rippler supports MPE, aftertouch, micro-tuning, MIDI tuning systems, and audio input routed into the resonator system. added.title: reFX Rippler Makes Acoustic Synthesis Feel Playable
added.excerpt: reFX Rippler Makes Acoustic Synthesis Feel Playable - Magnetic Magazine Home / Gear Physical modeling has always had a slightly strange promise inside music production. On paper, it sounds like the most natural thing in the room. Instead of triggering samples, the synth models the behavior of strings, tubes, membranes, plates, bells, drumheads, and other resonant bodies. The result can feel closer to an instrument reacting than a static recording playing back. In actual production, that realism can become the limitation. A modeled instrument can get locked too closely to the thing it is trying to imitate, while a subtractive synth can give you control but lose the organic instability that makes acoustic sound feel alive. reFX Rippler sits right inside that gap. added.title: Pittsburgh Modular Lifeforms SV-2 Sneak Preview
added.excerpt: Pittsburgh Modular founder Richard Nicol shared this teaser video for the Lifeforms SV-2 , a new semi-modular analog synthesizer. Details are still to be announced, but we expect it will build on the Lifeforms SV-1 , a retired Pittsburgh Modular design that offered a complete synth voice in Eurorack format. Nicol says the Lifeforms SV-2 is “perfect for complex tones or lo-fi noise’. He adds that the soundtrack of the teaser video was recorded by multi-tracking the Lifeforms SV-2 into Ableton Live, with EQ and compression added in the mix. Details for the Lifeforms SV-2 are expected to be announced Tuesday August 11, 2026. Leave a Reply Cancel reply

removed.title: New Gristleizer Plugin, Grizzly, For macOS & Windows
removed.excerpt: AOFN Audio’s Grizzly is a stereo modulation effect, based on the 1979 Gristleizer circuit, published by David Simpson in Electronics & Music Maker. It uses an internal LFO with triangle, square, rising saw, and falling saw waveforms to drive a modeled JFET stage in either VCA mode, which modulates the input amplitude, or VCF mode, which modulates a low-pass filter. The plugin includes adjustable modulation speed, depth, shape, offset, bias, drive, and stereo spread, with free-running or host-synchronized operation. Features: Modeled JFET stage based on the 1979 Gristleizer circuit VCA mode for amplitude modulation, including tremolo and rhythmic gating effects VCF mode for low-pass filter modulation Internal LFO with triangle, square, rising saw, and falling saw waveforms LFO speed from 0.
